info.title: Munshi API
info.description: A small public API that serves only what a shop's owner published, takes requests only with a publishable key, and never changes the books: every figure is a ledger row (a snapshot cell with its ref), and nothing you send changes the books until a person at the shop approves it. Simulated data on the demo deployment is labelled. A path parameter that fails its schema is an unknown route (404 not_found). Every POST and DELETE carries Idempotency-Key. A bad, revoked or wrong-origin key answers 404 as an unknown route; the member session cookie is never read here. Every response carries Munshi-Api-Version: 1.

publishableKey.description: A site's publishable key, for the public writes of that slug's site. Never in a URL, never logged.

secretKey.description: Deferred: specified, not built. Server to server only; a request with an Origin header is refused.

MunshiApiVersion.description: The major version, on every response.

RequestId.description: The request id, also in an error body.

ETag.description: The release id the response was built from.
